title: Each step request a lane sends to triage gets a reply in the same turn
why: Incident, 2026-11-07: lane lane-runs-tests-for-set sent triage a step request at 14:52 CST. Triage filed the step but never replied, so the lane waited about 3 hours, until the coordinator asked at 17:47 CST.
note: A Stop check for triage: each cross-session message received in the turn that names a step slug needs a send_message to its sender before the turn ends. Cost: one read of the turn's transcript at Stop. Done check: a red test on a turn that files a requested step and sends no reply.
